text:
mira: Heads-up — seeing a cluster of Xid 79/13 on us-west1-gpu-pool-12, but only on MIG slice 0.2 and 0.3. Multiple short bursts, ~5m windows.

sam: saw same. DCGM exporter shows ECC counters bumping then decaying in <2m. Alerts firing but then auto-resolve quickly.

mira: current prom rule triggers on any XID > 0 aggregated per gpu_card. That leads to noisy page floods.

diego: can you paste offending metrics?

mira: sure:

```

dcgm_gpu_ecc.single_bit_errors{gpu=\"card0\",mig_device=\"1\"} 3

dcgm_gpu_xid.error_count{gpu=\"card0\",xid=\"79\",mig_device=\"1\"} 4
```

katie: proposed rules update: add a warmup window + MIG-aware grouping, and require sustained rate > threshold across 10m.

sam: sketch of expr:

```

sum by(node,gpu) (increase(dcgm_gpu_xid.error_count[10m]))
>
bool 5
and on(node,gpu) dcgm_gpu_present == 1
```

diego: +1 but also need to ignore transient spikes from MIG slices — suggestion: aggregate at physical GPU level and only alert if > threshold and >50% of MIG slices report errors, or if physical ECC SB increases.

mira: new rule proto:

```

# alert if physical card sees >8 xid in 10m OR >3 xid AND >50% of its MIG devices reported >1

alert: UnhealthyGpuCard
expr: (
  increase(dcgm_gpu_xid_total[10m]) > 8
) or (
  increase(dcgm_gpu_xid_total[10m]) > 3 and
  (count_over_time((dcgm_gpu_xid_total > 0)[10m]) / count(dcgm_gpu_mig_info)) > 0.5
)
labels:
  severity: high

annotations:
  runbook: \"https://redwood.company/runbooks/gpu-unhealthy-card\"
```

katie: also add a 15m auto-silence for quick flares and a runbook link in the annotation.

sam: agree. Need to test on staging via alertmanager mute + simulate exporter spikes.

ops-bot: deploy-alerts: canary apply to staging prom rules: PR #4212

mira: I'll open the PR with tests (unit + e2e sim) and a follow-up to add node-label gpu_replacement_policy for RMA on flakies.

diego: If this reduces noise, ops saves about 10-15% on unnecessary drains — cost + capacity win.

katie: Action items: Mira -> PR, Sam -> run staging sim, Diego -> update oncall runbook to include MIG-check steps.

mira: ETA PR by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:

sam: 👍

alert-bot: Alert summary: 6 resolved, 2 suppressed by staging rule
